rules.title: A harness must not report success it did not measure
rules.text: A harness that measured nothing must not exit 0: a zero result and a missing result look identical in a table, and only one of them is a defect.

judgement.question: Is this success path reachable when nothing was measured — no model call, no finding, no assertion — so that a run which did nothing reports success?

criteria.true: an empty result set, a skipped model call, or a check that never ran reaches this return with exit 0, so a run that did nothing reports success
criteria.false: reaching it requires a measurement or an assertion before the return
